Extrafarma is a major Brazilian retail pharmacy chain that offers health and wellness products, but
it does not manufacture or brand its own continuous glucose monitors, smartwatches, or wearable medical devices
. Instead, retail locations and online pharmacies typically stock major third-party health tech brands.
Wearable Health Technologies Available in Retail Pharmacies
Continuous Glucose Monitors (CGMs):
Systems like the Abbott FreeStyle Libre track interstitial glucose levels in real time without routine finger pricks.
ZOE
Smartwatches & Wearable ECG:
Devices from brands like Apple, Samsung, and Fitbit provide on-demand single-lead ECG readings and continuous heart rate tracking.
JMIR Cardio
Sleep Trackers & Remote Monitoring:
Dedicated bands, rings (such as Oura), and smartwatches record sleep stages, blood oxygen (SpO2), and metrics shared with care teams.
